# No Auto Generated Boilerplate

Instruction content must be human-authored, not auto-generated boilerplate. Generated content lacks the project-specific context that makes instructions useful.

## Antipatterns

- Including a "Do not edit" banner at the top of an instruction file -- the check flags `do not edit` at the end of a line, directly followed by `.` `!` `:` or `;`, followed by a dash (`-` `–` `—`), a comment close (`*/`, `-->`), or followed by `this file`, `manually`, `by hand` or `directly`, such as `# DO NOT EDIT - changes will be overwritten`, `<!-- DO NOT EDIT: managed by scaffold -->` or `Do not edit directly; run make sync.`
- Copying a template that contains "Generated by [tool]" and forgetting to remove the attribution line -- the pattern matches `generated by` followed by any word.
- Using scaffolding tools that insert "auto-generated" headers into markdown files -- the check flags any variant of `auto-generated` or `auto_generated`.

## Pass / Fail

### Pass

~~~~markdown
# My Project

Use `pytest` for all test runs. Keep test files in `tests/`.
Run `uv run poe qa` before committing changes.
~~~~

### Fail

~~~~markdown
<!-- Auto-generated by setup-tool. Do not edit. -->
# My Project

This file was generated by `init-project`.
~~~~

## Limitations

Detects common auto-generated markers (`auto-generated`, a `do not edit` banner, `generated by`). A `do not edit` followed by what it protects ("Do not edit files under `gen/` by hand.", "Do not edit the lockfile.") is an instruction and is not flagged. May miss boilerplate without standard markers.
